uncited: **UV Volumes:** A 3D feature volume generated by a 3D sparse CNN.
Voxelize the latent codes $\mathbf{z}$ anchored on the SMPL vertices.
For a camera ray $\mathbf{r}$, sample $N$ points $\{\mathbf{x}_i\}_{i=1}^N$ along the ray between near and far bounds.
For each sample point $\mathbf{x}_i$, query the feature vector $f(\mathbf{x}_i, \mathbf{z}, \theta)$ from the UV volumes.
Render the feature volume into a 2D feature map $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{r})$ using standard volume rendering.
Interpolate texture embeddings from the NTS using the predicted UV coordinates and part assignments.
*   **SMPL Dependency:** Ray sampling bounds rely on the accuracy of the posed SMPL model.
*   **Part Assignment:** The part assignments $\hat{\mathcal{P}}$ must sum to 1.
